Short-video feed: daily challenge, 2027-01-29

The shared System Designer challenge for 2027-01-29: Short-video feed. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

People swipe through an endless feed of clips of 10 to 30 seconds. The next clip must already be on the phone before the swipe. One clip can suddenly get millions of views, and every view is a signal that picks what to show next.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
